_comment: Key sequence that gfa_run.py sends to the GFA-BASIC editor in FS-UAE.
Steps: key:<name> (with shift+/ctrl+/alt+/cmd+, optional *count), type:<text>, wait:<seconds>.
{file} is replaced by the Amiga path of the program, e.g. dh0:probe1.lst.
Checked on the original (GFA-BASIC 3.5 English, US keymap): New (Shift+F4) always asks
'NEW - Kill program?' (Return = Kill); the Merge requester (F2) has its file field preset to
the disk name with the cursor at the start, so it is cleared with Del before typing.
The first Return closes the alert ('Program End' or an error) left by the previous run.
